1|# Muse Code task: Homegrown product page (live demo), 2026-11-02
2|
3|Repo: ~/projects/forge. Two rounds, run as two separate Muse sessions. **Round P1 first; round P2 only
4|after P1 is checked.** Do not run any Modal, network or model call, and do not deploy. Claude deploys later, after the
5|user says yes. Do not touch `experiments/`, `results/`, `data/`, `company/`, the exam files or the wiki. You may only
6|import from `experiments/final/` (read-only).
7|
8|The design is decided by the user. **Copy it; do not redesign it.** Source of truth:
9|`docs/product/mockup/index.html` (v3: full-screen, FYNSEC-style frame, Familjen Grotesk, teal #1fa39a, animations,
10|hex-nut + sprout logo) with its assets `object.jpeg`. Copy text, layout, colours and animations exactly. The only
11|changes are the ones listed below.
12|
13|---
14|
15|## Round P1: the page (frontend only)
16|
17|Create `app/web/` with:
18|- `index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js` (split from the mockup; no build step, no framework), `object.jpeg` (copy).
19|- `recorded_run.json`: one demo run in the event format below (use the mockup's L-bracket story: write → build →
20|  measure finds "2 solids, expected 1" → fix → PASS). Mark it `"recorded": true`. Claude will replace it later with a
21|  real recorded run.
22|
23|Changes from the mockup:
24|0. Copy fixes (verifier S6): the proof card text becomes "on a 30-part CAD exam (15 hard), with its self-check loop
25|   (second look; one try: 83.3%). Best untrained setup: 94%." The hero subline and marquee "92%" items say
26|   "92% with its self-check loop". Every "~1 min" wake text becomes "a few minutes".
27|1. Remove the yellow "MOCKUP" pill.
28|2. The 3D object keeps a small caption under it: "Illustration".
29|3. The demo panel calls the real API:
30|   - On "Build it": first `GET /api/status` → `{"state": "ready"|"waking"|"paused", "message": str}`.
31|     - `paused`: show the message ("Demo paused: today's budget is used up…"), then play `recorded_run.json`
32|       labelled "Recorded run". Show the GitHub and video links and the form.
33|     - `waking`: show "Waking up the model (this takes a few minutes). Here is a recorded run meanwhile." Play the recorded run,
34|       then start the live run when it finishes.
35|     - `ready`: start the live run.
36|   - Live run: `POST /api/build` with JSON `{"job": text}`. The response is Server-Sent Events, one JSON object per
37|     event:
38|     `{"step":"write"|"build"|"measure"|"fix"|"done"|"error", "round":1..3, "detail":str, ...}`.
39|     The final `done` event carries `{"verdict":"PASS"|"CHECK FAILED", "measurements":{...}, "code":str,
40|     "stl_url":str, "step_url":str, "rounds":int, "seconds":float}`.
41|     Map the events onto the 5 existing step rows (same CSS classes as the mockup: on/done/fix). The timer shows
42|     "live run · N s", or "recorded run · N s" for the recording.
43|   - `done`: show the result row Three verdicts, three badges (verifier S1):
44|     `PASS` → teal badge "Self-check PASS" plus one line listing what was checked (e.g. "built · 1 solid · 80 × 30 × 45 mm
45|     matches your numbers"), and a small note "self-check, not the exam referee";
46|     `BUILT` → neutral badge "Built (size not checked)" with the reason;
47|     `CHECK FAILED` → neutral badge "Checks failed: see measurements". Never show PASS for anything else. Show the measurements as small chips, the code in a collapsible `<pre>`,
48|     and STL/STEP/code download links. Show a 3D view of the STL with three.js r160 from a pinned CDN URL
49|     (OrbitControls, steel material, slow auto-rotate, teal edges). If WebGL fails, hide the viewer.
50|   - `error` (HTTP 429/413/5xx or an error event): show the message from the server in the panel, never a stack trace.
51|4. Input: limit the textarea to 600 characters with a visible counter. The 3 example chips fill in full example jobs
52|   (write 3 realistic CadQuery jobs: L-bracket with 2 holes, flanged pipe adapter, electronics box with lid lip, each
53|   with all dimensions in mm).
54|5. Form: submits `POST /api/lead` with `{"tool":str,"email":str}`, then shows "Thanks, we read every answer." No
55|   other tracking, no cookies, no analytics. Under the form, one privacy line (verifier S7): "We only use your email to
56|   reply about Homegrown. To delete it, email us or send the form again with 'delete' as the tool." Contact address
57|   placeholder `CONTACT_EMAIL` in one place in app.js (Claude fills it in).
58|6. Links: GitHub = https://github.com/alyssaaa11/expertery ; the video link stays `#video` (filled in later).
59|7. `prefers-reduced-motion` keeps working. The page must also work at 390 px width (stack the columns; hide the
60|   dark corner tabs on mobile).
61|
62|Tests (`app/tests/test_web_static.py`, pytest, no browser needed):
63|- index.html, styles.css, app.js, object.jpeg and recorded_run.json exist; recorded_run.json parses, every event has a
64|  valid `step`, and it ends with `done` + `"recorded": true`.
65|- index.html contains the headline "The AI expert", "your company gets to", "keep." and no "MOCKUP".
66|- app.js references `/api/status`, `/api/build`, `/api/lead`, and contains no API key, no "VLLM", no "es_".
67|
68|Also add `app/web/dev_server.py` (stdlib only): serves `app/web/` on localhost:8099 with a FAKE API (status ready, a
69|build that streams the recorded events with 0.8 s gaps, a lead that returns ok), so Claude can test the page in a
70|browser without any model.
71|
72|---
73|
74|## Round P2: the backend (Modal web app)
75|
76|Create `deploy/modal_web.py` (Modal app name `homegrown-web`, CPU only, `min_containers=0`) and
77|`app/backend/` (pure-Python logic, importable and testable without Modal):
78|
79|- **Serving:** a FastAPI ASGI app that serves `app/web/` at `/`, plus:
80|  - `GET /api/status`: `paused` if the daily budget is used up; otherwise `ready` if a cheap probe of the model
81|    endpoint (`GET {FORGE_URL}/v1/models`, 3 s timeout) answers, else `waking` (and fire one non-blocking warm-up
82|    request).
83|  - `POST /api/build`: SSE stream as in P1.
84|  - `POST /api/lead`: append `{"tool","email","ts"}` to a Modal Dict `homegrown-leads` (email ≤ 200 chars, tool ≤
85|    300 chars; reject otherwise). Never log emails to stdout.
86|  - `GET /files/<run_id>.(stl|step|py)`: files kept in a Modal Dict `homegrown-files` for 24 h.
87|- **The loop (same as the 92% second look, FTX):** the model is the trained Glimmer served by
88|  `deploy/modal_forge.py` (served name `forge`; URL from env `FORGE_URL`; key from the existing Modal secret
89|  `forge-glimmer`, env `VLLM_API_KEY`). Messages start from `runner_final.ft_messages(job)`. Then up to 3 model calls:
90|  after a crash append the assistant reply and `runner.bx_error_message(error)`; after a build append
91|  `runner.bx_self_check_message(measure)`; a reply without a code fence ("DONE") ends the loop. Build every request body exactly as the FTX arm does (`runner.build_bx_body`: 16,000 max tokens, the same
92|  temperature/top_p/top_k, and the same reasoning setting). Make the reasoning strength ONE setting, env `REASONING_STRENGTH`
93|  (allowed: "high" or "xhigh"; default "xhigh" = what the 92% second look used, verifier F1). The decision is open: the user
94|  asked whether "high" (what the model was trained on) is better or faster; a small check on factory practice jobs decides
95|  before deploy. Test: the body sent to the model carries exactly the configured value. Import these helpers (`runner` is experiments/first-test/runner.py, imported by runner_final.py the same way); do not copy-paste them. If an import is impossible
96|  without side effects, stop and report it instead of rewriting them.
97|- **The box:** each answer runs in `cloud_cq.run_answer_in_box(code)` (the locked Modal sandbox, app `forge-cq`).
98|  Measurements come from its measure output. The **verdict on the page is a no-reference self-check**, because a
99|  visitor's job has no reference part: Three verdicts (verifier S1):
100|  `PASS` only if the part built, `solids == 1`, AND the job states an overall size that matches the bounding-box
101|  extents within 0.5% per axis; `BUILT` if it built with 1 solid but no overall size could be parsed (reason "size not
102|  checked"); `CHECK FAILED` otherwise, with reasons. "Overall size" is parsed ONLY from explicit patterns, written as a
103|  documented list of regexes, e.g. "overall (size|dimensions) A × B × C mm", "A x B x C mm box/plate/block",
104|  "base A × B × C mm" (+ "wall … N mm tall" adding height only when the job says so). Compare sorted extents to
105|  sorted stated numbers (axis order is not guaranteed). When unsure, return BUILT, never PASS. The function is `app/backend/selfcheck.py:self_check(job_text, measurements) -> (verdict, reasons)`.
106|  Keep it simple and conservative, and test it.
107|- **Files:** convert the built BREP to STL (tolerance 0.1 mm) and STEP inside the CPU web container (CadQuery 2.8.0,
108|  same pins as `cloud_cq.pip_spec()`). Never execute visitor-supplied or model code in the web container: only the
109|  sandbox runs code. The web container only reads the BREP that the sandbox returns.
110|- **Protection (all limits in one config block at the top of modal_web.py, read from env with these defaults):**
111|  - `MAX_JOB_CHARS=600` → 413.
112|  - Per IP: `MAX_BUILDS_PER_IP_HOUR=4` → 429 with "Please wait a bit…".
113|  - Global: `MAX_CONCURRENT_BUILDS=2` → 429 "Busy, try again in a minute".
114|  - (verifier S3) The web function runs with `max_containers=1`, and counters/limits live in that one process behind an
115|    asyncio lock (Modal Dict has no atomic counter; the Dict is only for persistence across restarts). The client IP
116|    comes from the connection peer / the LAST hop added by Modal's proxy, never the first X-Forwarded-For entry. Run
117|    ids are `uuid4().hex`.
118|  - **Daily budget:** `DAILY_CAP_USD=20` (the user's number; Claude may change it at deploy). Cost estimate per build
119|    = model GPU seconds × `GPU_USD_PER_S=0.000694` (A100-80GB ≈ $2.50/h) + `SANDBOX_USD_PER_BUILD=0.002`, plus
120|    (verifier S4) the idle tail after the last build of a burst: `IDLE_TAIL_USD=0.21` (300 s scale-down) charged once
121|    per burst, and `WAKE_USD=0.45` charged each time a warm-up is actually fired. Warm-ups are throttled: at most one per
122|    10 minutes globally and one per hour per IP; `/api/status` otherwise only reports the state and never wakes the
123|    model. The spend is kept in a Modal Dict keyed by
124|    UTC date. At or over the cap, `/api/status` returns `paused` and `/api/build` returns 429 with the paused message.
125|  - (verifier S5) A whole build has a `BUILD_LIMIT_S=600` wall-clock limit → error event "This part took too long;
126|    try a simpler one". Send the first SSE event immediately and a heartbeat comment at least every 15 s. The web
127|    function timeout is larger than the limit (≥ 660 s).
128|  - Model output and errors shown to visitors are capped at 4,000 characters and HTML-escaped by the page.
129|- **What goes into the web image (verifier S2):** an explicit file list only: `app/web/*`, `app/backend/*`,
130|  `experiments/final/runner_final.py`, `experiments/final/cloud_cq.py`, `experiments/final/run_cq_box.py`,
131|  `experiments/first-test/runner.py` and the minimum they import (list each file). Never `experiments/first-test/
132|  expected.json`, `jobs.py`, any `results/` or exam file. Use only `cloud_cq.run_answer_in_box`; do not use or deploy
133|  the grader app. Test: build the file list and assert the forbidden files are absent.
134|- No Claude, no other model, no analytics, no third-party calls except the three.js CDN in the page.
135|
136|Tests (`app/tests/`, pytest, all with fakes; no Modal, no network):
137|- the loop with a fake model + fake box: crash → fix → build → PASS gives event order write, build, fix, write, build,
138|  measure, done; messages match the FTX rules exactly (round 1 == ft_messages(job)); max 3 model calls;
139|- `self_check`: correct box → PASS; 2 solids → CHECK FAILED; wrong extent → CHECK FAILED; a job with no stated
140|  overall size → BUILT ("size not checked"), never PASS; ambiguous text → BUILT; each regex pattern has a test;
141|- limits: 601 chars → 413; 5th build from one IP in an hour → 429; a third concurrent build → 429; spend at the cap
142|  → status paused and build 429; the wake charge is added once per cold probe;
143|- the cost model: one build in a burst charges GPU seconds + sandbox + one idle tail; a fired warm-up charges WAKE_USD;
144|  a second warm-up within 10 min is not fired; status calls never wake the model by themselves;
145|- the IP used for limits ignores a spoofed first X-Forwarded-For hop; run ids are 32-hex uuid4;
146|- the SSE stream sends its first event before the first model call and a heartbeat during a slow fake model;
147|- `/api/lead` rejects a 201-char email; the lead is not printed to stdout;
148|- no secret value in any HTML/JS/JSON under app/web (grep for VLLM_API_KEY's env name and "es_").
149|
150|## Report (each round)
151|Diff summary, the exact pytest command and result (`.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q app/tests` plus the existing
152|`experiments/final experiments/r5` suites, which must stay green), and anything you could not follow or decided
153|differently (with the reason).

119|    = model GPU seconds × `GPU_USD_PER_S=0.000694` (A100-80GB ≈ $2.50/h) + `SANDBOX_USD_PER_BUILD=0.002`, plus
120|    (verifier S4) the idle tail after the last build of a burst: `IDLE_TAIL_USD=0.21` (300 s scale-down) charged once
121|    per burst, and `WAKE_USD=0.45` charged each time a warm-up is actually fired. Warm-ups are throttled: at most one per
122|    10 minutes globally and one per hour per IP; `/api/status` otherwise only reports the state and never wakes the
123|    model. The spend is kept in a Modal Dict keyed by
124|    UTC date. At or over the cap, `/api/status` returns `paused` and `/api/build` returns 429 with the paused message.
125|  - (verifier S5) A whole build has a `BUILD_LIMIT_S=600` wall-clock limit → error event "This part took too long;
126|    try a simpler one". Send the first SSE event immediately and a heartbeat comment at least every 15 s. The web
127|    function timeout is larger than the limit (≥ 660 s).
128|  - Model output and errors shown to visitors are capped at 4,000 characters and HTML-escaped by the page.
129|- **What goes into the web image (verifier S2):** an explicit file list only: `app/web/*`, `app/backend/*`,
130|  `experiments/final/runner_final.py`, `experiments/final/cloud_cq.py`, `experiments/final/run_cq_box.py`,
131|  `experiments/first-test/runner.py` and the minimum they import (list each file). Never `experiments/first-test/
132|  expected.json`, `jobs.py`, any `results/` or exam file. Use only `cloud_cq.run_answer_in_box`; do not use or deploy
133|  the grader app. Test: build the file list and assert the forbidden files are absent.
134|- No Claude, no other model, no analytics, no third-party calls except the three.js CDN in the page.
135|
136|Tests (`app/tests/`, pytest, all with fakes; no Modal, no network):
137|- the loop with a fake model + fake box: crash → fix → build → PASS gives event order write, build, fix, write, build,
138|  measure, done; messages match the FTX rules exactly (round 1 == ft_messages(job)); max 3 model calls;
139|- `self_check`: correct box → PASS; 2 solids → CHECK FAILED; wrong extent → CHECK FAILED; a job with no stated
140|  overall size → BUILT ("size not checked"), never PASS; ambiguous text → BUILT; each regex pattern has a test;
141|- limits: 601 chars → 413; 5th build from one IP in an hour → 429; a third concurrent build → 429; spend at the cap
142|  → status paused and build 429; the wake charge is added once per cold probe;
143|- the cost model: one build in a burst charges GPU seconds + sandbox + one idle tail; a fired warm-up charges WAKE_USD;
144|  a second warm-up within 10 min is not fired; status calls never wake the model by themselves;
145|- the IP used for limits ignores a spoofed first X-Forwarded-For hop; run ids are 32-hex uuid4;
146|- the SSE stream sends its first event before the first model call and a heartbeat during a slow fake model;
147|- `/api/lead` rejects a 201-char email; the lead is not printed to stdout;
148|- no secret value in any HTML/JS/JSON under app/web (grep for VLLM_API_KEY's env name and "es_").
149|
150|## Report (each round)

152|`experiments/final experiments/r5` suites, which must stay green), and anything you could not follow or decided

Round P1 is done. Only files under `app/` were created; nothing else touched.

Diff summary (all new, under `app/`):

- [app/web/index.html](~/projects/forge/app/web/index.html) — mockup markup with P1 copy changes: proof stat reworded to the 30-part/83.3% text, hero subline and marquee say “92% with its self-check loop”, “~1 min” → “a few minutes”, MOCKUP pill and title tag removed, “Illustration” caption under the object, textarea `maxlength=600` with counter, lead-form ids, privacy line, GitHub URL and `#video` links, three.js importmap.
- [app/web/styles.css](~/projects/forge/app/web/styles.css) — mockup CSS verbatim minus the pill rule, plus result badges, measurement chips, code box, viewer, and a ≤700 px query that stacks columns and hides the corner tabs; `prefers-reduced-motion` kept.
- [app/web/app.js](~/projects/forge/app/web/app.js) — status-gated build flow (paused / waking / ready), SSE live-run reader, recorded-run player, three verdict badges with measurements chips / collapsible code / STL-STEP-code links / three.js r160 STL viewer (hidden if WebGL fails), 600-char counter, three full example jobs, lead POST with thanks message, single `CONTACT_EMAIL` placeholder.
- [app/web/recorded_run.json](~/projects/forge/app/web/recorded_run.json) — 8-event L-bracket run (write → build → measure “2 solids, expected 1” → fix → write → build → measure → done PASS), every event marked `"recorded": true`.
- [app/web/object.jpeg](~/projects/forge/app/web/object.jpeg) — byte copy of the mockup asset.
- [app/web/dev_server.py](~/projects/forge/app/web/dev_server.py) — stdlib-only server for localhost:8099 with fake status-ready / SSE build (0.8 s gaps) / lead-ok API.
- [app/tests/test_web_static.py](~/projects/forge/app/tests/test_web_static.py) — the five pytest checks the spec asks for.

Test results:

- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q app/tests` → 5 passed.
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q experiments/final experiments/r5` → 115 passed.
- `git status` shows only `app/` as new from this session (the `results/muse-product-p1*` files pre-date it).

What I decided differently, and why:

- `recorded_run.json` is a JSON array of events with `"recorded": true` on every event (including the final `done`), rather than a dict with a top-level flag. The spec’s “it ends with done + recorded: true” reads as a property of the last event, and a flat event list is exactly what the SSE player and fake dev server consume. The test accepts a dict-with-`events` shape too, so a later replacement in either shape still passes.
- The paused/waking status line, “Recorded run” label, and GitHub/video links live in the run panel (`#apimsg`, `#golinks`) rather than reusing the footer. The footer links are also corrected, so both readings of “show the links and the form” are covered.
- The three.js viewer loads only on demand via dynamic `import()` when a run returns an `stl_url`. The page itself therefore makes no third-party call except the pinned CDN modules, and works fully offline against the fake server otherwise.
- I did not start the dev server (per the rules); it is compile-checked only, for Claude’s browser test at `http://localhost:8099` via `.venv/bin/python app/web/dev_server.py`.
